title: gRPC for Java Services
intro: gRPC interview questions cover the high-performance RPC framework increasingly common in microservice interviews — Protocol Buffers (proto3), the four service types (unary, server-streaming, client-streaming, bidi), interceptors, deadlines and cancellation, load balancing, gRPC vs REST vs messaging trade-offs, and the gRPC + Spring Boot integration patterns. This page is the one to use for any role that mentions internal service-to-service RPC at scale.
